role: Additive ablation on Gemma-3, 30 prompts, 2 ms / 100 ms / dynamic: PicoSpec (Fixed-4 + interrupt) -> + adaptive lookahead (markov_w0_fresh4_int: fresh 4, dist, interrupt) -> + adaptive fresh window (markov_w0_dist_int = CAPE-S); markov_w0_int (single median round-trip estimate instead of the distribution) isolates the distribution-aware overlap. The no-interrupt step comes from gemma3_20261026/gemma3_ablation (Fixed-4 vs fixed CAPE versions, different session).
candidate_definition: All methods of a phase run interleaved in one session (balanced per-prompt orders), so they share network and cloud conditions. CAPE = markov_*_dist_int: two-state geometric window model (priors, r=2.3, fresh 1..8, lookahead 2..9), distribution-aware round-trip overlap (last 64 round trips shifted to the median of the last 5), and PicoSpec-style interrupt of background drafting once verification rejects a sent token, priced by the model (common/pipeline_model.py choose_windows(interrupt=True), edge/edge_client_pipeline.py MarkovInterruptClient). Fixed windows all carry the interrupt: picospec_gN = fresh N, lookahead N+1, interrupted on rejection; picospec = N=4. sync_g4: no lookahead. PEARL gamma and PipeSD r1/r2 per pair and delay as in the earlier baseline runs (not retuned).
criteria: Each step vs the previous one and vs PicoSpec: throughput, J/token.
measurement: Draft: gemma-3-270m-it Q8_0 (ggml-org, sha256 0ef57d2c), --parallel 1 --ctx-size 2048 --cache-ram 256, no mmap, LLAMA_ARG_SWA_FULL=1, LLAMA_ARG_DIO=1; <bos> prepended via prepend_bos_id 2. Cloud: google/gemma-3-4b-it with vLLM online FP8, max_model_len 2048, verify_server.py hash 0dbd75 with prefix_cache_verify=true. Strict K1, target cap1, draft n_probs0. Gross Jetson board energy; equal 16-token warmups.
